title: Mock Test 7 - Reading
desc: Part 5-7, cau 101-167 (67 cau - PDF goc chi co toi cau 167, thieu 168-200). Co dap an va giai thich.

parts.directions: Chon tu/cum tu dung nhat de hoan thanh cau.

items.question: Several local food makers offer ------- own products to employees at reduced prices.
items.explanation: Before own products, a possessive adjective is needed.

items.question: Fawley Academy's ------- on absences caused by medical issues are explained in the student handbook.
items.explanation: Guidelines on absences is the natural noun phrase.

items.question: Check that the lid of the container is ------- sealed to prevent its contents from leaking.
items.explanation: Firmly is an adverb modifying sealed.

items.question: It is ------- that the accuracy of measuring instruments be tested yearly.
items.explanation: Vital fits the importance of yearly testing.

items.question: The new law will not affect homeowners whose property has been ------- at less than $80,000 in value.
items.explanation: Has been assessed is the correct passive form.

items.question: Taxi service should ------- be used when there is cheaper alternative transportation available during your business travel.
items.explanation: Never fits the warning not to use taxis when cheaper options exist.

items.question: This technique is meant to be ------- in treating muscle-related soreness.
items.explanation: Be employed is the correct passive form.

items.question: ------- this summer's unusual weather, it is no surprise that ice cream sales fell.
items.explanation: Given means considering the unusual weather.

items.question: To minimize any negative impact on tourism, the ------- of the famous statue will require careful timing.
items.explanation: The noun relocation is needed after the.

items.question: Ms. Migliacio asked that corrections to online articles be made ------- upon noticing errors.
items.explanation: Promptly means immediately after errors are noticed.

items.question: All of our products undergo ------- inspections at our manufacturing facility to ensure they meet high quality standards.
items.explanation: Strict inspections fits quality control.

items.question: Dr. Itaru Matsuda's studies have proven the ------- effects of the new medication on patients.
items.explanation: Advantageous is the adjective modifying effects.

items.question: You are provided a license to use Crombee until the end of next month under the ------- of this agreement.
items.explanation: Under the conditions of this agreement is the fixed meaning.

items.question: A company that is ------- for its corporate values will have greater success in attracting qualified job candidates.
items.explanation: Is respected for is the correct passive structure.

items.question: Although relatively few surveyed residents commute to work by bike, recreational bicycle use is -------.
items.explanation: Widespread contrasts with relatively few commuters.

items.question: Managers must submit revised deadline schedules ------- their projects face delays.
items.explanation: When introduces the condition of project delays.

items.question: The traffic sign was ------- visible from the road until the branches of a nearby tree obscured it.
items.explanation: Clearly is an adverb modifying visible.

items.question: Deenad Import-Export Ltd. operates a modern warehouse with floor space ------- 27,000 square meters.
items.explanation: Covering 27,000 square meters describes the floor space.

items.question: Clothing sales revenues are ------- even though the store's home goods remain popular.
items.explanation: Are declining is the correct progressive form.

items.question: The executive committee is proud to announce that ------- will soon resume negotiations with Pruneda Holdings.
items.explanation: We is the subject of will resume.

items.question: Human Resources reports that staff in a majority of departments are ------- absent during weeks that include national holidays.
items.explanation: Persistently is an adverb modifying absent.

items.question: Tours of select apartments ------- now that construction on the complex has been completed.
items.explanation: Tours receive the action, so passive will be allowed is needed.

items.question: ------- you find our mobile app satisfactory, please tap on the button below to leave a five-star review.
items.explanation: If introduces the condition.

items.question: The Karvex-K's advanced features are ------- with what professional photographers expect from a digital camera.
items.explanation: Consistent with means matching expectations.

items.question: Shoppers are encouraged to look around our store's entire showroom floor ------- they decide not to purchase anything.
items.explanation: Even if gives the concessive meaning.

items.question: The IT team ------- that all database systems be upgraded monthly.
items.explanation: Advises that systems be upgraded is correct.

items.question: Quality control officials found defects in a Phung's Apparel item just ------- over the course of a weeklong visit.
items.explanation: Just once means only one time.

items.question: ------- to package a new food product depends heavily on the item's brand image and target customer.
items.explanation: How to package means the method of packaging.

items.question: Patient records ------- with "Confidential" in red ink are subject to stronger protection measures.
items.explanation: Stamped is the reduced passive modifier.

items.question: The Snell Herald's career advice column enables readers to seize opportunities they may ------- at work.
items.explanation: Come across opportunities means encounter opportunities.

items.title: Response
items.text: Harold Bjorneby replies to Reba Shelton about a rental application and a credit check.

questions.explanation: The two-bedroom property is the unit.
Still contrasts the approval with the uncertainty about move-in date.
I have to take time is correct.

choices.A: The attached report explains the reasons for this refusal.
choices.B: Your e-mail did not clarify where to pay these fees.
choices.C: I will contact you again once the process is complete.
choices.D: We require the contract to be signed in person.

questions.explanation: It naturally leads into In the meantime.

items.title: Employee Satisfaction Survey
items.text: Human Resources explains that this year's survey will be anonymous and handled by an outside survey company.

questions.explanation: Expressing displeasure is the correct noun phrase.
Accordingly shows the decision follows from the concern.
Answers will be seen is the correct passive future.

choices.A: Last year, its findings were mostly positive.
choices.B: We hope that this puts your concerns to rest.
choices.C: It may take time to give thoughtful answers.
choices.D: Finally, organize the data collected into graphs.

questions.explanation: This reassures employees after explaining anonymity.

items.title: Membership confirmation
items.text: Underwood Home Forums welcomes a member and recommends reviewing its customized dictionary.

questions.explanation: Forums have topics.
Though gives the transition to advice.

choices.A: The terms of use agreement forbids the replication of our content.
choices.B: While using the site, you may encounter unfamiliar expressions.
choices.C: Although debate is encouraged, we ask that you remain polite.
choices.D: We do not verify claims made in member profiles or posts.

questions.explanation: The next sentence explains unfamiliar shorthand terms.
Recommend reviewing is the correct structure.

items.title: Coffee Machines in the Office
items.text: Resnell employees now have new coffee machines in each pantry.

choices.A: Pantries will be off-limits while they are installed.
choices.B: The reusable cups must be washed regularly.
choices.C: Interested employees should speak to their managers.
choices.D: The move is meant as a reward for a great first quarter.

questions.explanation: This explains the new benefit.
Their appearance was greeted is passive past.
Consequently connects the positive reaction to more pantry trips.
Limit usage of the machines is the intended meaning.

items.title: A Word from the Publisher
items.text: Drager's Weekly introduces a special issue honoring scientists.

questions.question: Where would the note most likely appear?

choices.C: In a book of collected writings

questions.explanation: Drager's Weekly usually covers current affairs, so it is a news magazine.

questions.question: What can be found on the page mentioned?

choices.D: The results of a reader poll

questions.explanation: The note says a complete list of interviewees is on page four.

items.title: The K270 Speaker by Prauss
items.text: Prauss advertises a portable outdoor speaker for barbecues and pool parties.

questions.question: For whom is the advertisement most likely intended?

choices.A: People who enjoy spending time outdoors
choices.B: People who are seeking discount electronics
choices.C: People who listen to music while driving

questions.explanation: The ad mentions backyard barbecues and pool parties.

questions.question: What is stated about the K270 Speaker?

choices.D: It comes with a carrying case.

questions.explanation: The shell is available in brilliant shades.

items.title: Valeria Kwon and Don Trousdale
items.text: Valeria and Don coordinate a model home tour for a potential buyer.

questions.question: Who most likely is Mr. Trousdale?
questions.explanation: He fixes a tenant's door handle and helps with home tours.

questions.question: At 10:28 A.M., what does Mr. Trousdale most likely mean when he writes, "Go right ahead"?

choices.A: He is happy to lend out a vehicle.
choices.C: Ms. Kwon should lead a house tour.
choices.D: He will return some keys to Ms. Kwon later.

questions.explanation: He agrees that Ms. Kwon should start showing the model home.

items.title: Maire Laundry Manual
items.text: The manual gives counter clerks procedures for serving laundry customers.

questions.question: What is indicated about Maire Laundry?
questions.explanation: The manual refers to all Maire Laundry locations.

questions.question: What are clerks instructed to do before accepting payment?
questions.explanation: Clerks clarify services such as stain removal before payment.

items.title: Busbyton Mall
items.text: Busbyton Mall promotes its new additions, restaurants, stage, architecture, playground, and VIP lounge.

questions.question: What is indicated about Busbyton Mall?

choices.C: It has more than two floors.

questions.explanation: The ad says the mall has grown and has new additions.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of Busbyton Mall?
questions.explanation: Public transportation is not mentioned.

questions.question: What are visitors who hold special memberships allowed to do?
questions.explanation: VIP members may unwind in the VIP lounge.

items.title: Box plan
items.text: Field Hughes confirms a three-month Burst of Glamour box plan and explains package cards and referral rewards.

questions.question: What is one purpose of the e-mail?

choices.C: To alert Ms. Joo to a shipping delay

questions.explanation: The email thanks her for signing up for a three-month plan.

questions.question: What is Ms. Joo instructed to read carefully?
questions.explanation: She should examine the card describing the package contents.

questions.question: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The ingredients of all cosmetics and edible goods are listed in full."
questions.explanation: The sentence fits after the warning about allergy-inducing products.

items.title: Vides Design Internship Program
items.text: Human Resources announces a summer internship program for Vides Design managers.

questions.question: Why was the e-mail written?

choices.A: To recruit speakers for a seminar series
choices.C: To describe the purpose of a new branch office
choices.D: To correct misunderstandings about a hiring process

questions.explanation: The email says the company will begin a summer internship program.

questions.question: What is indicated about Bostwick University?

choices.A: It has an excellent Graphic Design Department.
choices.B: It leads professional development courses in the summer.
choices.C: Vides Design is collaborating with it on a public art project.
choices.D: Several Vides Design employees graduated from it.

questions.explanation: A number of Vides staff are alumni of the university.

questions.question: What are readers of the e-mail asked to consider?

choices.A: The mutual benefits of a possible relationship.
choices.C: The basis for a customer complaint
choices.D: The best channel through which to advertise a position

questions.explanation: Managers must consider intern qualities and what their department can offer in return.

items.title: One-Day Workshop with Sophia Hong
items.text: The form gives the schedule for Sophia Hong's writing workshop and feedback gifts.

questions.question: What is the workshop most likely about?

choices.C: How to succeed as a writer

questions.explanation: Sophia Hong is a successful author and reviews story proposals.

questions.question: What were participants required to do before the workshop?

choices.A: Gather in the lobby of a building
choices.C: Purchase a set of note-taking tools
choices.D: Prepare ideas for a potential project

questions.explanation: Each participant submitted a story proposal before attending.

questions.question: What information is NOT included on the form?

choices.D: The topic of the morning discussion

questions.explanation: The form does not state the workshop location.

questions.question: What is indicated about participants who give feedback?

choices.A: They can receive a cloth sack.
choices.C: They must send in a form by post.
choices.D: They may register for a future event.

questions.explanation: One gift option is a canvas bookbag.
